title: The Gannon Storm — May 2024
description: A G5 extreme geomagnetic storm — the strongest in 20 years. Aurora visible as far south as Florida. Satellites experienced drag anomalies and communications disruptions worldwide.
historicalOutcome: Widespread aurora sightings across all 50 US states. Starlink reported degraded service. Multiple satellites entered safe mode. Power grid operators in northern latitudes activated contingency plans.
